fact_english: In Southeast Asia, including the Philippines, male fireflies of the genus Pteroptyx gather in trees, often along mangrove rivers, and flash in unison.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Sa ilang bakawan sa Timog-silangang Asya, kasama ang Pilipinas, sabay-sabay kumikislap ang mga alitaptap!

after_text: Pero kaya nating magturo nang mabilis.
why_here: Sebyo's light reply ends the scene where Indio goes to the master builder, and the montage of balangay yards from Batanes to Tawi-Tawi starts after it. Moved on 13 Nov from after the crossing into the future, where it played just before the vision of the drowned coast and the people left behind. Grave episode: gentle nature fact.
